easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Worker such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
description:
Kill Arcbound Worker.
When Arcbound Worker dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Worker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Worker dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
